title: Translation estimate for C^1 functions on balls
statement: Let n be a natural number and phi : R^n -> R continuously differentiable (ContDiff R 1 phi), where R^n = EuclideanSpace R (Fin n). Then for every real r and every z in R^n: int^-_(B_r) |phi(x - z) - phi(x)|^2 dx <= |z|^2 int^-_(B_(r+|z|)) |grad phi(x)|^2 dx, where B_rho := ball(0,rho), grad phi is Mathlib's gradient (Riesz representative of the derivative), the integrals are lintegrals of squared extended norms for Lebesgue measure, and the factor |z|^2 is ENNReal.ofReal(|z|^2).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ (r : ℝ) (z : Rn n), ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ (x - z) - φ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (‖z‖ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (r + ‖z‖), ‖gradient φ x‖ₑ ^ 2
